# tplink_firmware (Data Source)

Router model, hardware, and firmware identification.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tplink_firmware" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `firmware_version` (String) Firmware version string.
- `hardware_version` (String) Hardware revision.
- `model` (String) Router model name.
